items.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
items.title_zh: 拆解自动研究框架：上下文与技能如何塑造自进化 Agent
items.summary: The study isolates how context and skill management shape long-horizon autoresearch agents, finding that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts beats rolling summaries, with context folding improving over a recency-truncation baseline by up to 19.2%. Combining context folding with deletion of persistently unused lessons in MLEvolver reaches a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% fast@1 score on KernelBench Level 3.

items.title: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
items.title_zh: Engram：面向异构模型智能调优的多阶段记忆
items.summary: Engram is a multi-stage memory system that links past trial outcomes to the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether that evidence applies to the current model. An online agent supplies guidance, retrieves related sessions and reviews trial candidates, while an offline agent distills validated lessons; on two ads models it reaches a no-memory control's 32-trial result with 47% fewer trials.

items.title: Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
items.title_zh: Topology Hub 最优传输：以闪电速度消除长上下文稀释
items.summary: Topology Hub Optimal Transport replaces dense long-context attention with a linear-size hub-and-spoke transport graph and bounded-support gating to drive excess distractor mass to zero. On an NVIDIA L4, sparsemax THOT trained at 128 tokens reaches 97.40% zero-shot recall of fixed bindings at 262,144 tokens, and zero-shot WikiText-103 multi-needle retrieval reaches 100% versus 0.78% for short-trained RoPE FlashAttention.

items.title: Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 谁来给 Agent 打分？面向编程 Agent 基准测试的权限分离
items.summary: SplitBench is a privilege-separation framework that separates running a coding task's tests from judging their results, so an agent that takes over the whole test environment still cannot forge a pass because a trusted grader holds the expected answers. Porting Terminal-Bench and DeepSWE, 180 of 202 tasks converted with 98.7% agreement against native graders, and SplitBench blocked 75% of worst-case adversarial attempts.

items.title: Epistemic Guard: Out-of-Process MCP Receipt Proxying, Post-Turn Prose Supervision, and Provenance-Gated Memory for Tool-Using Autonomous Agents
items.title_zh: Epistemic Guard：面向工具型 Agent 的 MCP 凭证代理、回合后文本监督与来源门控记忆
items.summary: Epistemic Guard is an open-source Python library and out-of-process MCP receipt proxy that checks post-turn prose against signed tool receipts, gates SQLite memory writes by provenance, and collapses syndicated RAG mirrors. It reports 93.2% accuracy at 17.9 ms median CPU latency and rejects all tampered receipts in its conformance suites.

items.title: Taking the PULSE of Enterprise Workflows: Evaluating Persistent Project-State Understanding
items.title_zh: PULSE：评估企业工作流中的持续项目状态理解
items.summary: PULSE is a benchmark of 1,573 questions over 30 enterprise project histories that tests understanding of open loops, project evolution and view gaps. The authors report substantial headroom for retrieval, graph- and memory-augmented retrieval and long-context systems, and find that supplying explicit project state on top of gold evidence yields further gains.

items.title: DM-Lab at TREC 2026 RAG: Multi-Query Retrieval, Ensemble Judging, and Claim-Pack Generation
items.title_zh: DM-Lab 在 TREC 2026 RAG：多查询检索、集成评判与声明包生成
items.summary: DM-Lab-RAG-2026 combines multi-query BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, ensemble relevance assessment, listwise reranking and adaptive retrieval depth over the 553-million-document ClimbMix-400B corpus, then generates claim-first cited answers with source verification. Across 22 development topics it reports mean nDCG@30 of 0.604, and in official evaluation a set precision of 0.455 with a manual nugget gain of 0.910.

items.title: Correct Precedents Induce Policy Violations in On-Device LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 正确先例反而诱发违规：端侧 LLM Agent 的策略失效
items.summary: The paper identifies correct-precedent generalization, in which an on-device agent that correctly releases an item whose restriction was lifted becomes more likely to release the next still-restricted item, and finds the failure in 13 open-weight models from nine developers. Paired Decision Distillation restores the safe rate to nearly 100% in every distilled model without extra prompts or model calls.

items.title: SLICR: Strategy Logic-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: SLICR：策略逻辑引导的多智能体强化学习
items.summary: SLICR extends specification-guided reinforcement learning to adversarial, partially observable multi-agent settings by using Strategy Logic to quantify over agent strategies and linear temporal logic to encode objectives and constraints. It is evaluated on Predator-Prey, Google Research Football and a home-grown extension of SMAC-HARD.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.summary: OpenAI describes a layered approach to adversarial distillation that combines model training, safeguards, detection and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.title_zh: Hebbia 借助 GPT-6 Astra 在金融研究上取得提升
items.summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research, and its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance and presentation quality.
